SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION REPORT — NO REAL PATIENT DATA

SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
Specimen: Right lower lobectomy

FINAL DIAGNOSIS:
- Invasive adenocarcinoma.
- Tumor size: 3.2 cm in greatest dimension.
- Visceral pleural invasion is present.
- Pathological T category: pT2a.
- Eight regional lymph nodes are negative for metastatic carcinoma (0/8).
- Pathological N category: pN0.

reports.description: Synthetic LUAD report with an explicit addendum that supersedes preliminary size and pT values
reports.text:
SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION REPORT — NO REAL PATIENT DATA

SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
Specimen: Left lower lobectomy

PRELIMINARY DIAGNOSIS:
- Invasive adenocarcinoma.
- Tumor size: 2.8 cm in greatest dimension.
- Pathological T category: pT1c.
- Pathological N category: pN0.

ADDENDUM:
This addendum explicitly supersedes the preliminary tumor size and pathological T category. Complete sampling establishes a tumor size of 4.1 cm and a revised pathological T category of pT2b.

REVISED FINAL DIAGNOSIS:
- Invasive adenocarcinoma.
- Tumor size: 4.1 cm in greatest dimension.
- Pathological T category: pT2b.
- Pathological N category: pN0.

reports.text:
SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION REPORT — NO REAL PATIENT DATA

SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
Specimen: Right middle lobectomy

FINAL DIAGNOSIS:
- Invasive squamous cell carcinoma.
- Tumor size is conflicting: the gross section records 3.8 cm and the microscopic section records 4.2 cm; no reconciled final measurement is designated.
- Pathological T category is conflicting: the synoptic section records pT2a and the narrative section records pT2b; neither entry is designated final.
- Pathological N category is conflicting: one section records pN0 and another records pN1; neither entry is designated final.
